<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># ArgoCD 升级操作手册

</span>&gt; 适用范围：EKS 生产集群 ArgoCD `v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span> → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.x → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x` 两跳升级  
</span>&gt; 生产命名空间：`argocd` | 演练命名空间：`argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test`

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 目录结构

```
argocd</span>-jenkins/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── README.md                          # 本手册
├── argocd</span>-check-v32.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>                # 升级后只读巡检（生产/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">演练通用）
├── argocd</span>-upgrade-post-v31-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>    # 生产第一跳升级后修复（NS=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">argocd）
├── argocd</span>-upgrade-post-v32-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>    # 生产第二跳升级后修复（NS=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">argocd）
├── argocd</span>-backup-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>              # 生产备份（NS=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">argocd，升级前必须执行）
├── argocd</span>-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>             # 生产从备份完整恢复（NS=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">argocd）
├── argocd</span>-fix-manager-rbac-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>    # 修复目标集群 argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">manager RBAC（在目标集群执行）
└── argocd</span>-test/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ├── argocd</span>-backup-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>               # 演练备份（NS=argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test）
    ├── argocd</span>-restore-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>              # 演练从备份完整恢复（NS=argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test）
    ├── argocd</span>-delete-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>               # 演练清理命名空间（NS=argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test）
    ├── argocd</span>-fix-manager-rbac-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>     # 修复目标集群 argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">manager RBAC
    ├── argocd</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span>-manifest-test.py       # 将 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml 的命名空间替换为 argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test（演练用）
    ├── argocd</span>-setup-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>                # 演练环境初始化（仅 argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test NS）
    ├── argocd</span>-upgrade-post-v31-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>     # 演练第一跳升级后修复（NS=argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test）
    └── argocd</span>-upgrade-post-v32-test.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>     # 演练第二跳升级后修复（NS=argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test）
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 前置条件

### 工具

```bash
# kubectl 已配置并指向目标集群
kubectl version </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client
kubectl config current</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">context

# python3 </span>+ PyYAML（演练 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 脚本依赖）
python3 </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
pip3 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyyaml
```

### 权限确认

```bash
# 确认对 argocd 命名空间有 apply 权限
kubectl auth can</span>-i create deployment -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd
kubectl auth can</span>-i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> configmap -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

# 确认 ClusterRole 操作权限（</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.yaml 含集群级 RBAC）
kubectl auth can</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i create clusterrole
```

### 升级前状态快照

```bash
# 确认当前版本
kubectl </span>-n argocd get deployment argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server \
  </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 确认所有 Pod 健康
kubectl </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd get pods

# 确认 Redis HA 正常
kubectl </span>-n argocd get pods -l app=argocd-redis-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ha
kubectl </span>-n argocd get service argocd-redis-ha-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">haproxy

# 确认 replicas（升级后需恢复为 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">）
kubectl </span>-n argocd get deployment argocd-server argocd-repo-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server \
  </span>-o=custom-columns=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NAME:.metadata.name,REPLICAS:.spec.replicas</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 确认 argocd</span>-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm 当前值（升级前记录，apply 后会被重置）
kubectl </span>-n argocd get configmap argocd-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm \
  </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | python3 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">m json.tool
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 升级 YAML 准备

</span>&gt; **说明**：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml 必须使用 `ha/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.yaml`（含 Redis HA StatefulSet），
</span>&gt; 不能用默认的 `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml`。生产直接使用原始 HA YAML，无需 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 命名空间。

### 回滚备用 YAML（v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，升级前提前准备）

```bash
# 升级前提前下载，回滚第一跳时需要
curl </span>-fsSL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3.0.6/manifests/ha/install.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>-o argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span>-ha-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prod.yaml
```

### 第一跳 YAML（v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x）

```bash
# 确认最新 v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> 版本：https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/releases</span>
# 示例使用 v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，实际替换为当前最新版本
V31</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v3.1.16</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

curl </span>-fsSL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/${V31}/manifests/ha/install.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>-o argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prod.yaml

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下载完成: argocd-install-v31-ha-prod.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

### 第二跳 YAML（v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x）

```bash
# 确认最新 v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> 版本：https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/releases</span>
V32=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v3.2.12</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>   # 替换为实际版本，如 v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

curl </span>-fsSL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/${V32}/manifests/ha/install.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>-o argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v32-ha-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prod.yaml

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下载完成: argocd-install-v32-ha-prod.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

### dry</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">run 预检（apply 前必做）

```bash
# 第一跳预检
kubectl apply </span>--dry-run=server -f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-prod.yaml -n argocd <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -E <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error|Error|Warning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dry-run 通过</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 第二跳预检
kubectl apply </span>--dry-run=server -f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v32-ha-prod.yaml -n argocd <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -E <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error|Error|Warning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dry-run 通过</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 生产升级流程

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：升级前备份

```bash
# 在 argocd</span>-jenkins/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 根目录执行
.</span>/argocd-backup-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 输出：.</span>/argocd-backup-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 确认末尾出现 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">备份完整性验证通过</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 再继续
```

备份内容：Application </span>/ AppProject /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApplicationSet CR、ConfigMap、Secret、
ClusterRole</span>/CRB、CRD、Deployment/StatefulSet/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Service，并生成 `manifest.txt` 记录资源数量。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>：第一跳升级（v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span> → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x）

```bash
cd argocd</span>-jenkins/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   # 回到根目录

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 应用新版本 YAML
kubectl apply </span>-f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 等待 rollout 完成（按顺序等，确保依赖链就绪）
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status statefulset/argocd-redis-ha-server        --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-redis-ha-haproxy        --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server                  --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-repo-server             --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-applicationset-controller --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-notifications-controller  --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status statefulset/argocd-application-controller   --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 立即执行修复脚本（apply 会通过三路合并重置 argocd-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm，必须立即恢复）
.</span>/argocd-upgrade-post-v31-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

修复脚本自动处理：
</span>- 恢复 `redis.server=argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6379</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- 恢复 `server.insecure=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- 强制恢复 `replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>`（argocd-server、argocd-repo-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server）
</span>- 校验 `argocd-manager-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">role` 保护状态
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Redis HA 连通性验证

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>：第二跳升级（v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.x → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x）

```bash
# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 应用新版本 YAML
kubectl apply </span>-f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v32-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 等待 rollout 完成
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status statefulset/argocd-redis-ha-server        --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-redis-ha-haproxy        --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server                  --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-repo-server             --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-applicationset-controller --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-notifications-controller  --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status statefulset/argocd-application-controller   --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">300s

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 立即执行修复脚本
.</span>/argocd-upgrade-post-v32-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x 额外检查（修复脚本自动执行）：
</span>- `applicationset-controller` RBAC 新增 `coordination.k8s.io/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">leases` 权限
</span>- 手动验证：`kubectl get clusterrole argocd-applicationset-controller -o yaml | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> coordination`

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 回滚流程

### 触发条件

</span>- `CrashLoopBackOff` 持续 &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分钟
</span>- Degraded Application 比例 &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>%
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Redis HA 连通失败且无法自愈

### 第二跳回滚（v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.x → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x）

```bash
# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 回滚镜像
kubectl apply </span>-f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 立即修复 CM（apply 会重置，必须立即 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，不能等待）
kubectl </span>-n argocd <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">type merge \
  </span>-p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{"data":{"redis.server":"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379","server.insecure":"true"}}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 恢复 replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
kubectl </span>-n argocd scale deployment argocd-server argocd-repo-server --replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 重启使 CM 生效
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout restart deployment/argocd-server deployment/argocd-repo-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout restart statefulset/argocd-application-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">controller
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">180s
```

### 第一跳回滚（v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.x → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">）

```bash
kubectl apply </span>-f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span>-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

kubectl </span>-n argocd <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">type merge \
  </span>-p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{"data":{"redis.server":"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379","server.insecure":"true"}}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

kubectl </span>-n argocd scale deployment argocd-server argocd-repo-server --replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout restart deployment/argocd-server deployment/argocd-repo-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout restart statefulset/argocd-application-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">controller
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">180s
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 从备份完整恢复

适用场景：回滚后仍异常、CR</span>/ConfigMap/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Secret 数据损坏。

```bash
# 在 argocd</span>-jenkins/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 根目录执行
# 脚本启动时会显示备份 manifest.txt 内容，并要求输入 yes 确认 kubectl context
.</span>/argocd-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> argocd-backup-&lt;YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS&gt;/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

恢复顺序（任一步骤失败立即中止）：

</span>| 步骤 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> | CRD apply + 等待 `Established` |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> | 命名空间 |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> | ClusterRole / ClusterRoleBinding |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> | ServiceAccount / Role / RoleBinding / ConfigMap / Secret |
| 4a | ConfigMap 恢复后强制校验 redis.server + server.insecure |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> | Service / Deployment / StatefulSet + 等待 rollout 就绪 |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> | Application / AppProject / ApplicationSet CR |
| 验证 | 与 manifest.txt 核对资源数量，不匹配则 exit <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> |

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 升级后巡检

```bash
.</span>/argocd-check-v32.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

检查项：
</span>- argocd-server 镜像版本符合 v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 所有 Pod Running，无 CrashLoop
</span>- Pod 重启次数（&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 需关注）
</span>- argocd-cmd-params-cm 中 redis.server /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> server.insecure 值
</span>- replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>（argocd-server、argocd-repo-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server）
</span>- Redis HA HAProxy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ping</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 连通性
</span>- applicationset-controller RBAC（coordination.k8s.io/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">leases）

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 跨集群 RBAC 修复

</span>**症状**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：ArgoCD UI 中目标集群 Application 显示 `SyncFailed`  
</span>**日志**：`User <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system:serviceaccount:kube-system:argocd-manager</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cannot get resource`

```bash
# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 切换到目标集群（不是 ArgoCD 所在集群）
kubectl config use</span>-context &lt;target-cluster-context&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 执行修复
.</span>/argocd-fix-manager-rbac-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 切回 ArgoCD 集群，触发重新同步
kubectl config use</span>-context &lt;argocd-cluster-context&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
argocd app </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sync</span> &lt;app-name&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 或在 ArgoCD UI 点击 Sync </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Refresh
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

```bash

## 关键配置说明

</span>| 配置项 | 值 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `redis.server` | `argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6379</span>` | `kubectl apply -f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml` 通过三路合并重置此字段，**每次 apply 后必须立即 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span>** |
| `server.insecure` | `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>` | TLS 在 Ingress 层终止，同上，apply 后会被重置 |
| `replicas` | 生产=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> / 演练=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml 可能覆盖为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>，升级后升级脚本自动强制恢复 |
| `ha/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml` | 必须用 HA 版本 | 包含 Redis HA StatefulSet，普通 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml 无 Redis HA |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### argocd</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span>-manifest-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test.py 说明

仅演练环境需要。作用：将 `</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml` 中所有 `namespace: argocd` 深度替换为 `argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">test`，
覆盖 metadata、subjects、webhooks 等所有位置，并保留 CRD。

```bash
# 用法
python3 argocd</span>-test/argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span>-manifest-test.py &lt;input-ha.yaml&gt; &lt;output-test.yaml&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

生产环境直接使用原始 `ha</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml`，不需要 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 常见问题

</span>**Q: apply 后 argocd-server CrashLoop，日志显示无法连接 Redis**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: `</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml` 三路合并重置了 `argocd-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm`。立即执行：
```bash
kubectl </span>-n argocd <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">patch</span> configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">type merge \
  </span>-p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{"data":{"redis.server":"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379","server.insecure":"true"}}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
kubectl </span>-n argocd rollout restart deployment/argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
```

</span>**Q: applicationset-controller 报 Forbidden（v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.x）**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.x 新增了 `coordination.k8s.io/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">leases` 权限。检查 ClusterRole 是否包含：
```bash
kubectl get clusterrole argocd</span>-applicationset-controller -o yaml | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">A3 coordination
```
若缺失，重新 apply `argocd</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v32-ha-prod.yaml` 并执行 `./argocd-upgrade-post-v32-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`。

</span>**Q: 恢复后 Application 数量少于备份记录**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: `argocd</span>-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span>` 末尾会对比 `manifest.txt` 并 exit <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。先检查 CRD 是否 Established：
```bash
kubectl get crd </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> argoproj.io
kubectl </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">wait</span> crd/applications.argoproj.io --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=condition=Established --timeout=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">60s
```
CRD 就绪后重新执行 `.</span>/argocd-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> &lt;backup-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dir</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`。

</span>**Q: dry-run 报 unknown field 或 CRD 不存在**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: 目标集群 CRD 版本与 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.yaml 不匹配。先 apply CRD 部分：
```bash
kubectl apply </span>-f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd \
  </span>--selector=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argocd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --dry-run=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
```

</span>**Q: argocd-manager-role 在目标集群丢失**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: 切换到目标集群执行修复，再回 ArgoCD 集群触发同步：
```bash
kubectl config use</span>-context &lt;target-cluster-context&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
.</span>/argocd-fix-manager-rbac-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
kubectl config use</span>-context &lt;argocd-cluster-context&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
argocd app </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sync</span> &lt;app-name&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

</span>**Q: Redis HA HAProxy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ping</span> 失败（需要密码）**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
A: 生产 Redis 配置了 AUTH，redis</span>-cli 需要 `-a &lt;password&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` 参数，或通过 Secret 获取：
```bash
REDIS_PASS</span>=$(kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-redis-ha -o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.data.auth}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | base64 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">d)
kubectl </span>-n argocd exec &lt;redis-ha-pod&gt; -c redis --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  redis</span>-cli -h argocd-redis-ha-haproxy -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6379</span> -a <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${REDIS_PASS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ping</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```</span></pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">readme.md</span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>

# ClusterRole
kubectl get clusterrole </span>-o yaml <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> | python3 - &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PYEOF</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${BACKUP_DIR}/clusterroles.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<pre>#!/usr/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bash
# argocd</span>-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 从备份恢复 argocd 命名空间资源 </span>+ 集群级 RBAC +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CRD
#
# 使用方法：
#   .</span>/argocd-restore-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> &lt;backup-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dir</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#
# 恢复顺序（每步均有错误检查，任何失败立即中止）：
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 前置校验（context 确认 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 备份目录完整性）
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. CRD（apply +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 等待 Established，再进行下一步）
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 命名空间
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>. ClusterRole /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClusterRoleBinding
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>. ServiceAccount / Role / RoleBinding / ConfigMap / Secret（+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CM 强制校验）
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>. Service / Deployment / StatefulSet（+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 等待 rollout 就绪）
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>. Application / AppProject /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApplicationSet CR
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 恢复后计数核对（与 manifest.txt 对比）
set </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">euo pipefail

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>

# 前置校验 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 关键备份文件存在性检查

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[PRE] 备份目录完整性检查...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
PRE_FAIL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> configmaps.yaml secrets.yaml crds.yaml; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ ! -f <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${BACKUP_DIR}/${f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ]] || [[ ! -s <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${BACKUP_DIR}/${f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ 关键备份文件缺失或为空: ${f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        PRE_FAIL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ✅ ${f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">done</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${PRE_FAIL}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -eq <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ 备份目录不完整，中止恢复（请重新执行 ./argocd-backup-prod.sh）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    exit </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 工具：清理 kubectl export YAML 中的运行时字段，apply 前必须去除
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clean_yaml() {
    python3 </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PYEOF</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import sys, yaml

def clean(obj):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> not isinstance(obj, dict):
        return obj
    # 移除运行时字段
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> key <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">resourceVersion</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generation</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">creationTimestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">selfLink</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">managedFields</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        obj.pop(key, None)
    metadata </span>= obj.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">metadata</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {})
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> key <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">resourceVersion</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generation</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">creationTimestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">selfLink</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">managedFields</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        metadata.pop(key, None)
    # 移除 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">last</span>-applied-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">configuration（可能超大，引发 apply 失败或三路合并异常覆盖 redis.server）
    annotations </span>= metadata.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">annotations</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {})
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> annotations:
        annotations.pop(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, None)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> not annotations:
            metadata.pop(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">annotations</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, None)
    # 移除 status（避免 apply 冲突）
    obj.pop(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, None)
    # 递归清理子字段
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> v <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> obj.values():
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(v, dict):
            clean(v)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(v, list):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> v:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(item, dict):
                    clean(item)
    return obj

input_file </span>= sys.argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
with open(input_file) as f:
    docs </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list(yaml.safe_load_all(f))

FINAL_REDIS</span>=$(kubectl -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get configmap argocd-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm \
    </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.data.redis\.server}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
FINAL_INSECURE</span>=$(kubectl -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get configmap argocd-cmd-params-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cm \
    </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.data.server\.insecure}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${FINAL_REDIS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${REDIS_HA_ADDR}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ✅ redis.server: ${FINAL_REDIS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ redis.server 最终值错误: [${FINAL_REDIS}]（预期 ${REDIS_HA_ADDR}）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    VERIFY_FAIL</span>=$((VERIFY_FAIL + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${FINAL_INSECURE}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ✅ server.insecure: true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⚠️  server.insecure: [${FINAL_INSECURE}]（预期 true）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${crd_count}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -lt <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⚠️  argoproj.io CRD 数量 ${crd_count} &lt; 4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ✅ argoproj.io CRD: ${crd_count} 个</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${VERIFY_FAIL}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -gt <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=====================================================================</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ 恢复验证有 ${VERIFY_FAIL} 项失败，请检查上方详情</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

    exit </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>

# 生产集群说明：
#   </span>- NS=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">argocd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（生产命名空间）

#
# 使用方法：
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. kubectl apply -f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v31-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd

has_node_taint() {
    kubectl get nodes </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.items[*].spec.taints[*].key}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
        </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">tr</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -q <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">^${1}$</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

check_pods_healthy() {
    local bad
    # 排除 Terminating：rolling upgrade 过渡期旧 Pod 正常处于此状态
    bad</span>=$(kubectl -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get pods --no-headers <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
        </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Running\|Completed\|Terminating</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -c <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${bad}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -gt <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⚠️  有 ${bad} 个 Pod 未处于 Running 状态：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        kubectl </span>-n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get pods --no-headers | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Running\|Completed\|Terminating</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ 回滚触发条件：CrashLoopBackOff &gt; 5min / Degraded App &gt; 30%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  回滚命令：kubectl apply -f argocd-install-v3.0.6-ha-prod.yaml -n ${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        return </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  kubectl -n ${NS} logs ${HA_POD} -c redis --tail=50</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⚠️  未找到 Redis HA Pod（label: app=argocd-redis-ha），请手动验证</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<pre>#!/usr/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bash
# argocd</span>-upgrade-post-v32-prod.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# ArgoCD v3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.x → v3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.x 升级后修复脚本（argocd 生产环境，第二跳）
#
# 生产集群说明：
#   </span>- NS=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">argocd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（生产命名空间）
#   </span>- replicas=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>（升级后强制恢复，<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>.yaml 覆盖时可能降为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">）
#   </span>- Redis HA：argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6379</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#   </span>- argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">manager ClusterRole 受保护（kubectl apply 不删除，此处仅校验现状）
#
# 使用方法：
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. kubectl apply -f argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-v32-ha-prod.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 等待所有 Pod Running
#   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 立即执行本脚本
set </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">euo pipefail

NS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">argocd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
REDIS_HA_ADDR</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=====================================================================</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ArgoCD v3.1.x → v3.2.x 升级后修复（argocd 生产环境 — 第二跳）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  命名空间: ${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  时间: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

has_node_taint() {
    kubectl get nodes </span>-o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.items[*].spec.taints[*].key}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
        </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">tr</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -q <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">^${1}$</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

check_pods_healthy() {
    local bad
    # 排除 Terminating：rolling upgrade 过渡期旧 Pod 正常处于此状态
    bad</span>=$(kubectl -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get pods --no-headers <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
        </span>| <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Running\|Completed\|Terminating</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -c <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [[ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${bad}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -gt <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ]]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⚠️  有 ${bad} 个 Pod 未处于 Running 状态：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        kubectl </span>-n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get pods --no-headers | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">grep</span> -v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Running\|Completed\|Terminating</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⛔ 回滚触发条件：CrashLoopBackOff &gt; 5min / Degraded App &gt; 30%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  回滚命令：kubectl apply -f argocd-install-v31-ha-prod.yaml -n ${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        return </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">--- replicas ---</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> deploy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> argocd-server argocd-repo-server; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ${deploy}: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    kubectl </span>-n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> get deployment <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${deploy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -o jsonpath=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{.spec.replicas}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">done</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=====================================================================</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  修复完成 ✅  (argocd 生产环境 — 第二跳)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  [v3.2.x 行为变更验证要点]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    1. applicationset-controller RBAC: coordination.k8s.io/leases 权限</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">       检查: kubectl get clusterrole argocd-applicationset-controller -o yaml | grep coordination</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    2. install.yaml apply 后 redis.server 被重置 → 脚本已恢复</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    3. argocd-cmd-params-cm 中 server.insecure 被重置 → 脚本已恢复</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    ✅ replicas=2 已强制恢复</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  [回滚操作] 如升级后出现 CrashLoopBackOff &gt; 5min 或 Degraded App &gt; 30%：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 1. 回滚至 v3.1.x：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl apply -f argocd-install-v31-ha-prod.yaml -n ${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 2. 强制恢复 CM（install.yaml apply 会重置 argocd-cmd-params-cm，必须立即 patch）：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl -n ${NS} patch configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm --type merge \\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">        -p '{\"data\":{\"redis.server\":\"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379\",\"server.insecure\":\"true\"}}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 3. 恢复 replicas=2：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl -n ${NS} scale deployment argocd-server argocd-repo-server --replicas=2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 4. 重启使 CM 生效：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl -n ${NS} rollout restart deployment/argocd-server deployment/argocd-repo-server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl -n ${NS} rollout restart statefulset/argocd-application-controller</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    kubectl -n ${NS} rollout status deployment/argocd-server --timeout=180s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 5. 若需完整回滚至 v3.0.6（重复步骤 1-4，使用 v3.0.6 yaml）：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl apply -f argocd-install-v3.0.6-ha-prod.yaml -n ${NS}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl -n ${NS} patch configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm --type merge \\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #        -p '{\"data\":{\"redis.server\":\"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy:6379\",\"server.insecure\":\"true\"}}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl -n ${NS} scale deployment argocd-server argocd-repo-server --replicas=2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl -n ${NS} rollout restart deployment/argocd-server deployment/argocd-repo-server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl -n ${NS} rollout restart statefulset/argocd-application-controller</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 6. 若 argocd-manager RBAC 丢失（目标集群执行）：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    kubectl config use-context &lt;target-cluster-context&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    ./argocd-test/argocd-fix-manager-rbac-test.sh</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    # 7. 若 CR/ConfigMap 数据损坏，从备份完整恢复：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #    ./argocd-test/argocd-restore-test.sh argocd-backup-&lt;YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS&gt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=====================================================================</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
